title: MAP: Security checkpoints & data handling milestone (draft)
text:
MAP: Security checkpoints & data handling milestone (draft)

['From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@medlytics.health>, Tom Choi <tom.choi@medlytics.health>, MedLytics Security <security@medlytics.health>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Security checkpoints & data handling milestone (draft)
Attachments: medlytics_map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_security_sheet.pdf (pdf)

Hi Dana / Tom / Sec team —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion, I’m attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan that isolates the data handling & compliance milestone you requested. The goal of this thread is to get alignment on responsibilities, showstoppers, and a target close date so we can move the procurement/legal conversation in parallel.

Key context (from call):
- Use case will process clinical questionnaires and some lab metadata; MedLytics flags this workload as potentially PHI-bearing.
- Primary requirement: HIPAA-safe processing + full auditability of admin access.
- Preference: private deployment (VPC) if possible; evaluating whether hosted & contractual controls could work.

Draft MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (security checkpoints)
- Objective: Approve deployment model and acceptance criteria to handle PHI/PII workloads.
- Target close date: 2026-07-30 (customer target)
- Deliverables:
  1) Data residency & storage plan (where logs / artifacts are stored) — owner: MedLytics (confirm) / Redwood to propose options
  2) Audit logging & retention spec (access logs, admin actions, model access) — owner: Redwood (Aisha)
  3) PHI/PII handling rules (redaction/tokenization, what never persists in logs) — owner: MedLytics + Redwood
  4) Key management & encryption profile (KMS/HSM, key custody) — owner: Redwood (ops) + MedLytics (KMS requirements)
  5) Compliance evidence package (SOC 2 report, penetration test summaries, BAA draft) — owner: Redwood (Aisha / Legal)
- Dependencies: procurement timelines, BAA execution, environment provisioning (VPC), and whether a Private deployment is required.

Immediate asks for this week:
1) MedLytics: confirm whether PHI will be present in requests or only derived/summary outputs (quick answer: yes/no) — this will change the path (hosted vs private).
2) MedLytics Security: target retention windows for logs & audit trails (min/max) and any regulatory retention requirements.
3) Redwood: provide a short security evidence packet and KMS/HSM options by EOD Friday.

Internal owners I’ve looped: Rafael (pricing / terms), Stephanie (onboarding & post-sales), Aisha (security evidence / SOC2). Rafael / Aisha / Steph — flag anything I missed or needs to be stronger in the milestone.

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll update the attached MAP with your answers and re-circulate a redline by Monday 7/13.
- Schedule a short 30-min follow-up with security + legal if MedLytics confirms PHI in requests.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

', 'From: Tom Choi <tom.choi@medlytics.health>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@medlytics.health>, MedLytics Security <security@medlytics.health>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Security checkpoints & data handling milestone (draft)

Thanks, Soojin — useful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- PHI scope: the request payloads will include patient identifiers and free-text notes in early testing. We expect to sanitize some fields but cannot guarantee zero PHI in initial phases.
- Retention: audit logs must be kept for 12 months minimum; longer retention may be required for certain studies (we’ll confirm if 3 years is needed for a subset).
- Audit trail: we need immutable logs of model inputs + admin access with exportable audit reports for compliance (CSV/JSON)
- Deployment preference: MedLytics strongly prefers private deployment in our cloud account (VPC), with customer-managed KMS keys. Hosted would be acceptable only if we can negotiate strict contractual controls + key custody.

We will send our security questionnaire (initial answers) by end of day Monday. Also, can Redwood confirm whether logs ever contain raw request text in hosted mode by default? If so, what controls exist to suppress or redact that data?

Tom
Director, Platform & Security
MedLytics

', 'From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Choi <tom.choi@medlytics.health>, Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@medlytics.health>, MedLytics Security <security@medlytics.health>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Security checkpoints & data handling milestone (draft) — updated actions

Tom — great, thanks for the detail. Quick replies inline and an updated action list below.

- PHI in payloads: noted — target path will be Private deployment unless MedLytics wants to approve a hosted model with strict key-custody & contractual commitments.
- Retention: we’ll propose default audit retention at 12 months with an extension option (configurable) to support 3-year needs for named studies.
- Logs: Redwood’s hosted runtime can be configured to avoid persisting raw request bodies by default; we can offer both redaction hooks and a mode that never stores request text. For Private deployments, logs remain in the customer VPC and are subject to their retention policies.

Updated MAP milestone (actionable items with owners & dates):
- A1: Confirm PHI posture (MedLytics) — owner: Dana / Tom — due 2026-07-12
- A2: Choose deployment model & key custody (MedLytics + Redwood) — owner: MedLytics / Rafael — due 2026-07-16
- A3: Audit log retention & export format (Redwood) — owner: Aisha Rahman — due 2026-07-14
- A4: Provide SOC2 + pentest summary & BAA draft (Redwood) — owner: Aisha Rahman — due 2026-07-16
- A5: Procurement & legal review kickoff (MedLytics / Redwood) — owner: Rafael Mendes — due 2026-07-20
- A6: Environment provisioning (VPC) & KMS setup (ops) — owner: MedLytics infra + Redwood infra — dependency: BAA & procurement — due 2026-07-23

Proposed target close: 2026-07-30 (coordinated handoff to onboarding once procurement complete)

Attachments: updated MAP (medlytics_map_v1.xlsx) — I highlighted the data milestone tab and added the owners above. Rafael — please confirm pricing impact for private deployment / KMS options and whether we need a contract amendment.

Next steps:
- Dana/Tom: please confirm A1 answer and share the security questionnaire when ready (we’ll ingest & respond).
- Aisha: I’ll need the SOC2/pentest summary + a short note on how we enable log redaction/no-store modes for hosted customers.
- Rafael: estimate delta for private deployment and customer KMS custody.

Thanks all — I’ll follow up Monday with a redlined MAP if I have A1 answer.

Best,
Soojin

', 'From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: MedLytics MAP — immediate asks (security evidence + pricing delta)

Internal — quick sync items pulled from the external thread above. This is an internal action note (do not forward to MedLytics without Rafael/Aisha sign-off):

1) Aisha — can you assemble: SOC 2 Type II executive summary, latest pen test high-level findings, and a two-paragraph description of how Redwood configures log redaction / no-store for hosted endpoints? Target: 2026-07-14 COB. Attach to the shared drive link below.
2) Rafael — can you model a pricing delta for Private deployment + customer-managed KMS (one-time setup + monthly capacity premium)? Quick ballpark by EOD 7/16 so we can commit to the 7/16 owner deadline in the MAP.
3) Stephanie — prep a short note on onboarding timeline post-procurement (how long for VPC provisioning + runbook handoff).
4) Legal / Contracts: Rafael, please flag if BAA needs special clauses for audit exports or bespoke retention windows.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abcd1234 (MAP + evidence folder), HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/12345

I’ll draft the redline MAP + reply to MedLytics once A1 is confirmed.

—
Soojin
